$meta.description: Registry for Operation A (content-pages mesh): per content page, identity, section inventory, and the related-terms list with dispositions toward visual tools. Stores only cross-app data invisible from any single file. Backlinks are earned by demonstration value; mechanical reciprocity with Line 2 is forbidden.

conventions.pageKey: route-qualified key '<section>/<slug>' (e.g. 'trigonometry/identities', 'set-theory/operations') - bare slugs collide across sections
conventions.template: titled (sections have real slug ids) | untitled (empty section titles, structure investigation required before planting)
conventions.relatedTerms: Built on first mapping: prose scanned against definitionsRepository + formulasRepository (own section), plus each section's central subject. Status: linked | dropped (reason) | deferred (no ready tool demonstrates it; re-query as tools mature) | pending (must not survive a pass).
conventions.units: A linked term carries link records; unit is null for link-only plants (tool fits, visual does not - in-situ illustration later) or {diagrams, arrangement: single|sequence|adjacent-sections, newStates}. Visual form (2026-07-30): one attached frame - SVG left, tinted explanation panel right with divider, link inside the panel text. Built by app/components/demo-unit/demoUnitFrame.js inside getStaticProps, passed via props, rendered as a content-array item with dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Never interpolated into sectionsContent strings.
conventions.conceptToolMap: Site-wide best-demonstrating-tool decisions, written the first time a concept is linked anywhere, obeyed by every later pass.
conventions.populationRule: Universal registry rule: any pass touching a page updates its registry entry as a by-product, whatever the operation.

algebraic_multiplicity.why: Repeated vs defective states are the distinction.

basis.why: Coordinates in a chosen basis are the tool subject.

cofactor_matrix.why: The adjugate route to the inverse.

column_space.why: One of the four spaces the tool draws.

dimension.why: Collapse from plane to line as independence fails is dimension made visible.

eigenspace.why: Repeated-eigenvalue state shows the whole space.

eigenvalue.why: Characteristic-polynomial roots; the symbolic route readers meet first.

eigenvector.why: Invariant directions are best seen geometrically.

homogeneous_system.why: The none/unique/infinite outcomes are the tool states.

left_null_space.why: One of the four spaces the tool draws.

linear_combination.why: Three phases scale-scale-add are exactly the concept.

linear_independence.why: Independent vs dependent is the tool toggle.

linear_transformation.why: The grid deforming under the matrix is the concept.

matrix.why: The generator shows what a matrix is and what kinds exist.

orthogonal_complement.why: The orthogonality pairing between the four spaces is a state of the tool.

orthogonal_vectors.why: Orthogonality reads off the inner product being zero.

pivot.why: Pivots are highlighted at each elimination step.

positive_definite_matrix.why: The not-positive-definite state is the failure the tool shows.

projection.why: Vector-onto-vector is the elementary case; projection-2d is the matrix view.

reduced_row_echelon_form.why: A named stage of the tool.

row_echelon_form.why: A named stage of the tool.

row_space.why: One of the four spaces the tool draws.

scalar.why: Scaling is the whole content of the tool.

similar_matrices.why: Same map in two bases is what similarity means.

singular_matrix.why: Zero determinant is where singularity appears.

span.why: Is b in the span - the tool answers exactly this.

subspace.why: Membership test against a spanned set is the tool question.

unit_vector.why: Normalisation is a state of the magnitude tool.

vector.why: Arrows built component by component; the most basic place a vector is seen acting.

vector_space.why: Closure under combination is what the span region shows.

sine.why: Sine as a coordinate: the legacy unit-circle tool draws the vertical leg and its value directly. Concept is the function itself; its graph is a separate concept (see graph of sine).

cosine.why: Cosine as the horizontal leg on the unit circle.

tangent.why: Tangent as the slope of the radius, read from the two legs; the tool prints Undefined at 90/270.

cotangent.why: Reciprocal read off the same two legs.

quadrant sign pattern.why: The sign of each of the six functions by quadrant is the whole content of the functions-signs tool. Recorded on trigonometry/unit-circle section 4 under the four reciprocal/quotient entities.

reference_angle.why: The angle-explorer concept state marks the reference angle against the nearest x-axis half; it is the Line 1 reference implementation.

period.why: One full cycle of a graph; same tool as periodicity.

amplitude.why: Read off the bounded wave between -1 and 1.

graph of sine.why: The curve, as opposed to the value: functions-graphs draws each of the six curves with a marker.

positive_angle.why: Direction of rotation: the angle-types directed overview shows +45 and -45 side by side.

negative_angle.why: As direction of rotation. The even-odd symmetry identities are a separate concept (see even-odd symmetry).

even-odd symmetry.why: cos(-t)=cos t, sin(-t)=-sin t as a reflection on the unit circle.

supplementary_angles.why: Supplementary overlay toggle, paired with the complementary one (already in the map).

hypotenuse.why: Sides and ratios of a right triangle.

opposite_side.why: Sides and ratios of a right triangle.

adjacent_side.why: Sides and ratios of a right triangle.

zeros of sine and cosine.why: Where the terminal side lies on an axis the corresponding leg vanishes; the special-angle hover state shows the 0 value.

asymptotes of trigonometric functions.why: Vertical asymptotes of tan, cot, sec, csc are drawn on the graphs.

graph of cosine.why: The curve; see graph of sine.

graphs of reciprocal functions.why: csc, sec, cot curves over their parents.

solutions of a basic trigonometric equat.why: Two mirrored special-angle points share one sine value; hover boxes show it.

average_rate_of_change.why: Secant slope over an interval, drawn as Δy/Δx.

tangent_line.why: Tangent at a point with its slope readout.

differential.why: Linear approximation is the tangent line; dy is read along it.

critical_point.why: Lists every critical point of a family on an interval; tangent-line max state used on the hub for the single-point picture.

extreme_value_theorem.why: Critical points and endpoints compared on a closed interval.

second_derivative_test.why: Sign of f'' at a critical point.

higher_order_derivative.why: The second derivative as the shape of the bend.

derivative.why: f and f' graphed together with a marker at x = 1.

riemann_sum.why: Rectangles on [0,3] for x^2, n = 8, four sample rules.

definite_integral.why: Shaded area from a to x with F(x) read above.

signed_area.why: Shading below the axis counts negative on the accumulation curve.

limit.why: Probes at c ± 0.5 closing in on c.

one_sided_limit.why: The onesided and jump families of the limit explorer.

asymptote.why: Vertical asymptote: the 1/x^2 and 1/x families. Horizontal asymptotes have no state (deferred).

discontinuity.why: Hole, jump, wrong value, asymptote, staircase; the oscillating case uses the limit explorer since the checker has no such family.

domain.why: Valid inputs shaded on the x-axis.

asymptote (functions).why: Vertical, horizontal and oblique asymptotes drawn as lines.

inverse_function.why: f, f^-1 and the mirror line y = x.

one_to_one_function.why: Horizontal line test and the restricted parabola.

composition_of_functions.why: f(g(x)) and g(f(x)) side by side.

absolute_value_function.why: As two pieces; as a family member it also appears in types and range.

transformation.why: Parameters a, k, b, h on f(x) = x^2.

complex_plane.why: A point plotted from its real and imaginary parts.

complex_conjugate.why: Reflection in the real axis with equal moduli.

modulus.why: Arrow length readout; polar-rectangular where the section is about r and theta together.

argument.why: Angle from the positive real axis with quadrant check; multiplication where the section is about arguments adding.

multiplicative_inverse.why: Division picture; the De Moivre inverse state for the geometric section.

imaginary_unit.why: e^(i theta) on the unit circle; the i-powers cycle for the powers section.

powers of i.why: Four-cycle with the current power highlighted.

de moivre theorem.why: Spiral of powers; no state shows n-th roots (deferred).

roots_of_unity.why: DEFERRED: no frozen state shows roots; the visualizer has power states only. Left deferred-to-in-situ-illustration on every page.

remainder.why: Leftover tiles after complete rows; the wheel where the page is about modulo.

divisibility rule.why: Column patterns for 2 and 4; the decision tree for the digit-sum rule.

greatest common divisor.why: Repeated division rows down to remainder 0.

element.why: Membership and containment drawn as nested circles (set-theory basics).
